'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Robbie Hendon LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Robbie Hendon]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Robert Hendon
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
